08/ Dated 14.06.2024  Heard the parties.
The petitioner is apprehending his arrest in connection with Argora P.S. Case No. 175 of 2020, for the offences under Sections 420 and 409 of the Indian Penal Code, pending in the Court of Sri Achhat Srivastava, learned Judicial Magistrate-XIII, Ranchi.
It is alleged that at the instance of this petitioner, the informant had obtained license from Jaat Beverages Private Limited for sale of liquor.
Jaat Beverages Private Limited had obtained franchisee from German Company.
As per the agreement, the petitioner had to deposit 10,000/- Euro to the German Company for carrying out of his business.

The allegation is that the company of the petitioner had not deposited 10,000/- Euro to the German Company, for which, the notice has been sent by mail the German company and thereby, hampering his business prospects.

Ms. Khalida Haya Rashmi, learned counsel for the petitioner has drawn attention to this Court towards an agreement between the petitioner and the informant, in which, it was nowhere mentioned that the firm of the petitioner was to deposit 10,000/- Euro to the German Company.
Learned counsel for the opposite party No.2 was asked to show from the agreement as to where it has been stated that the petitioner company had to deposit 10,000/- Euro.
It has been stated that there is no specific clause in the agreement in this regard.
Considering the aforesaid facts; I am inclined to extend the privilege of anticipatory bail to the petitioner.

He is directed to surrender before the court below within two weeks from the date of Rakesh Thappar vs The State Of Jharkhand on 14 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/37860712/
1 receipt of a copy of this order and the learned court below on his surrender shall release him on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each, to the satisfaction of Sri Achhat Srivastava, learned Judicial Magistrate-XIII, Ranchi,
in connection with Argora P.S. Case No. 175 of 2020, subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438 (2) Cr.P.C.
BS/ (Ambuj Nath, J.)
